method: read-only audit plus safe local fix; no production writes, no auth/secret changes, no migrations, no deployment

issues.title: Packaging includes local macOS .DS_Store, making the ZIP non-reproducible across macOS/CI
evidence: Local repackage produced 49 files vs committed 48
Extra entry: project/.DS_Store; content of all other files identical
CI runs on Ubuntu where .DS_Store is absent
issues.resolution: Added a noise-file filter (.DS_Store, Thumbs.db, desktop.ini) to the packaging script.
verification: git diff --stat on the ZIP => no bytes changed (matches HEAD)
issues.productionImpact: None; build artifact only. Not yet pushed.

issues.title: No-hint independent review pass leaves review task in_progress on Staging cloud
evidence: Local verify-phase-e.mjs covers exact no-hint causal chain and second targeted review; 18/18 passed this run
review-engine makeEvent injects taskId, targetGapEventIds and causationEventIds on assessment_passed
Failure reproduced only in Staging cloud E2E (assessment_passed independent=true, hintsUsed=0, but no learning_task_completed)
issues.requiredFix: Reproduce with a real staging account, then verify review-workspace submit-success branch calls task-orchestrator.complete with the correct taskId and exact targetGapEventIds causal chain; persist learning_task_completed for no-hint pass only. Do NOT relax validation.
issues.blocker: Requires staging credentials and a real account; sync-mechanism scope was explicitly frozen by the user.
issues.productionImpact: Affects plan progress, review queue and user-visible task status; production data not written.

issues.title: Committed data/search.json drifts from source; nav text extracted into record bodies
evidence: build-search-index.py --check fails against committed index, passes after rebuild (134 records)
58 body differences: 'KNOWLEDGE BASE 知识总览 ...' injected into <main> by the site shell and captured as body
issues.rationale: Production CI rebuilds the index on every deploy, so live search is current. Changing extraction affects all 134 records and is a product decision.
issues.suggestion: Add a data-search-skip marker or dedicated body container in the site shell, then regenerate the index.

issues.title: Production AI Provider secrets missing; real model capability unverified
evidence: 4.1 audit: missing AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY/MODEL; Staging practice generation returned HTTP 546
issues.blocker: Need user to configure production secrets; no secret values read or written.

issues.blocker: Auth changes require explicit user authorization; not modified.
